desc: COMPLETE FREEWHEEL CLUTCH UNIT FND-Z SERIES
tech: GMN one-way clutch, also known as a freewheel clutch, and is part of the FND series. These clutches utilize sprag-type mechanisms for unidirectional power transmission. The \"Z\" in the model name indicates a specific spring type used to hold the sprags in place, in this case, a tension spring.  Features are :  High Torque and Space Saving, Sprag-type Mechanism, Complete Freewheel Clutch Unit, One-way Clutch. These clutches are used in various applications where one-way motion or overrunning is required, such as in automation, robotics, and machinery.  The inner ring has a keyway for secure attachment to a shaft, while the outer ring is designed for a press fit into a housing.

It is necessary to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race.

desc: ONE WAY ROLLER CLUTCH- US SERIES FREEWHEELS
tech: The US Series freewheels are not self-centering. It is therefore required to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race. US freewheels have ball bearings with the same dimensions as the 62.. Series. The torque forces are transmitted from the shaft to the inner race by means of a key and from the outer race to the seating by means of an interference fit on the r6 tolerance of the external diameter. Shaft tolerance must be either h6 or j7; the tolerances for the seating must be either H7 or J6.

GMN roller ramp clutch, specifically the VS series, and potentially the VS model. These clutches are designed for applications requiring one-way (freewheel) or overrunning functionality. They are often used in various industrial applications where a rotating component needs to freewheel in one direction and transmit torque in the other. Features are : High torque capacity, Compact design, Long service life, Easy mounting. Applications : Backstops, Overrunning clutches, Indexing mechanisms, Backstopping in elevators. These clutches utilize rollers that engage with ramps to transmit torque. When the clutch is engaged (driving), the rollers are forced against the ramps, creating a locking action and transmitting torque. When the clutch is disengaged (overrunning), the rollers move away from the ramps, allowing the driven component to rotate freely.

desc: USNU ONE WAY ROLLER FREEWHEEL CLUTCHES
tech: The USNU Series freewheels are not self-centering. It is therefore necessary to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race. The torque forces are transmitted from the shaft to the inner race by means of a key and from the outer race to the seating by means of front pullers or by means of an interference fit if the seating tolerance is made a K6. Shaft tolerance must be either h6 or j7; the tolerances for the seating must be either H7 or F7. When front pullers are not used, the seating tolerance should be K6.

Shaft tolerance must be either h6 or j6; the tolerances for the seating must be either H7 or G7. When front pullers are not used, the seating tolerance should be K6.

For the UK ZZ model, the transmission occurs by fitting keying with n6 tolerance for shaft and N6 for the seat. The UK ZZ Series is built with a C5 clearance that turns into a normal clearance after keying. The races can be glued to the shaft and the seat. In this case, the clearance remains C5. Working temperature: -10°C +60°C.

Roller Ramp Clutches manufactured by GMN Bearing. The VGL series is part of GMN\'s roller ramp clutch offerings, which are known for their rust protection and heavy-duty applications. These clutches often have integrated bearing support, and some sizes utilize ball bearings while others use sleeve bushings. These clutches are designed to connect two shafts and can absorb shock loads and vibrations. Features are : Roller Ramp Clutch, Flange and Cover Options, Shaft Connection. These clutches are used in various applications where one-way motion control is needed.

desc: SPRAG TYPE ONE WAY FREEWHEEL CLUTCH BEARING
tech: Type CB  is a sprag type free wheel not self-centring. It is therefore necessary to place one or two bearings next to the free wheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race. A key will transmit the torque between outer ring and the shaft. The tolerance of the housing bore must be H7. CB  series can be lubricated with grease or oil but they must not have EP additives.

desc: FREEWHEEL CLUTCH INSERT ELEMENT FE-Z SERIES
tech: GMN freewheel clutch insert element, specifically a sprag-type freewheel. It\'s designed for applications like backstops, indexing, and overrunning. This component is characterized by its space-saving design, high torque capacity, and ability to handle high-speed swivel motions. It\'s not self-centering and requires external bearing support.  Features are : Space-saving, Lightweight and compact design, High-speed swivel, High precision positioning, Minimal inertia, Uniform load distribution, Oil or grease lubrication. The freewheel clutch insert element requires axial constraints on both sides. External bearing support to define the gap between mating parts (Shaft and housing) is necessary. The \"Z\" indicates a tension spring design.

This component is characterized by its space-saving design, high torque capacity, and ability to handle high-speed swivel motions. It\'s not self-centering and requires external bearing support.  Features are : Space-saving, Lightweight and compact design, High-speed swivel, High precision positioning, Minimal inertia, Uniform load distribution, Oil or grease lubrication. The freewheel clutch insert element requires axial constraints on both sides. External bearing support to define the gap between mating parts (Shaft and housing) is necessary. The \"Z\" indicates a tension spring design.

Operating Temperature: Maximum 170°C (RL 443 and RL 448 max. 150°C). Applications: Used in backstop, indexing, or overrunning clutch applications.

tech: (Bore Dia 3/4 INCH / .750 INCH /19.05 MM) The GO type freewheels have contacting parts and are self centering on ball bearings. They have an oil lubricated watertight seal. By adding the suffix GR (GO – GR), they are supplied already greased. By adding the suffix GRL (GO – GRL), they are supplied with a labyrinth seal and already greased. Shaft tolerance must be h6.

CKZ-A TYPE is sprag type freewheels, self contained, sealed and bearing supported, using two ball bearings. Unit is delivered oil or grease lubricated according to the type. The inner race is keyed to the shaft, the outer race has a h7 tolerance to give a fit in H7 housing and it is screwed to the bond. This type extensive used in machinery of packing, traffic, metallurgy, mine and so on. to realize backstop or overrunning in dule drives. Ambient temperature range is 5° To 40° C., or attaching pulleys, gears or sprockets to the clutches, insert hubs (with f7 tolerance of ISOR773) along the inner surface of the outer race and screw the bolts (high tension) into the tapped holes on the clutch end.

This series extensive used in machinery system of conveyor, hosting, packing, printing, papermaking, corrrugated machine, food and so on.

GC-A TYPE is a roller type freewheel non-bearing supported. Bearings are required to support axial and radial loads. Lubrication and sealing must also be provided by the installation. Nominal outer diameter is the same as a series 63...Ball bearing. A typical arrangement is to install this type alongside a bearing within the same location tolerances, as shown on the following page. The inner race is keyed to the shaft. The outer race has positive n6 tolerance, to give a press fit in a H7 housing. Additional side notches in the outer race provide for positive torque transmission. If the housing is to K6 tolerance, use of the notches is not necessary, but the housing must be strong enough to not expand after assembly. This design can accept an axial misalignment of inner and uter race of ± S/2.

desc: USNU ONE WAY ROLLER FREEWHEEL CLUTCHES
tech: The USNU Series freewheels are not self-centering. It is therefore necessary to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race. The torque forces are transmitted from the shaft to the inner race by means of a key and from the outer race to the seating by means of front pullers or by means of an interference fit if the seating tolerance is made a K6. Shaft tolerance must be either h6 or j7; the tolerances for the seating must be either H7 or F7. When front pullers are not used, the seating tolerance should be K6.

desc: SPRAG ONE WAY FREEWHEEL CLUTCH BEARING
tech: The UK ZZ series is a freewheel incorporating a 62 series bearing. The self-centring freewheels are already greaselubricated and come with dust-proof protection. For the UK ZZ model, the transmission occurs by fitting keying with n6 tolerance for shaft and N6 for the seat. The UK ZZ Series is built with a C5 clearance that turns into a normal clearance after keying. The races can be glued to the shaft and the seat. In this case, the clearance remains C5. Working temperature: -10°C +60°C.

These types are supplied greased-for-life and with gasket.

The GF Series freewheels are self centering. From size 8 to size 20, centering is steel on steel, while from size 25 to 130, centering is ensured by 2 160 series bearings. Torque forces are transmitted from the shaft to the inner race by means of a keyway and from the outer race to the seat by means of front pullers. Shaft tolerances must be either h6 or j6, seating tolerances must be H7 or G7. If no front pullers are used, the seating tolerance becomes K6.

This model is equipped with a keyway on the inner race and should be fitted on k6 tolerance shafts. Seat fitting must be carried out with N6 keying tolerance. The GM Series  is a cage with contact elements running on a metric sized freewheel race. The smaller dimensions and the high transmission torque offer some interesting technical and cost-saving solutions. Fitting multiple cages side-by-side increases torques. It is necessary to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race.

desc: ONE WAY ROLLER TYPE FREEWHEEL CLUTCHES
tech: The UF Series freewheels are not self- centering. It is therefore necessary to place one or two bearings next to the freewheel so that the outer race can rotate centrally to the inner race. The torque forces are transmitted from the shaft to the inner race by means of a key and from the outer race to the seating by means of front pullers. Shaft tolerance must be either h6 or j6; the tolerances for the seating must be either H7 or G7. When front pullers are not used, the seating tolerance should be K6.

desc: LD-K Series Light Duty At Low Speed
tech: The LD-K series is for application with light duty at low speed application and incorporating onto a V-pulley, timing pulley or sprocket. Pre-lubricated with special grease and are ready for use, therefore no additional lubricant is required. Torque Range : 0.6~5 kgf.m, Bore Range : ø10~ø30. The bores of the pulley, sprocket, etc., should have a tolerance of H6 or H7. Never apply thrust loads to the clutch. Be sure to attach the plate, this prevents the outer race from slipping away from the innerrace.

PB series clutch features precision formed cams providing high torque capacities with excellent wear life. These models are suitable for general duty applications. Torque Range : 3~215 kgf.m, Bore Range :ø10~ø45. Mechanical Clutches offer the most complete and versatile selection of backstop, overriding, and index Clutches in the industry. A bonze seal maintains race concentricity. They a asymmetrical by design, so must be ordered according to rotation requirements. For indexing use, oil lubrication is recommended. These units can be operated in ambient temperature of -6℃∼55℃.

One-Way Clutch Bearing is a specialized component that allows unidirectional motion while preventing motion in the opposite direction. Its design and application can vary widely, making it a versatile solution for a range of mechanical systems that require controlled and selective motion transmission. Features are :  Torque is positively transmitted by rollers that wedge against interior ramps.  Available as clutch only or as a clutch and bearing assembly. Clutch only units should be used with external radial support to hold the shaft and housing.

CKL-A TYPE is a roller type freewheel, self-contained, sealed and bearing supported, using two 160...Series bearings. Unit is delivered oil lubricated. This combination is used as overrunning clutch as shown overleaf. In this design, a standard AL freewheel is connected to a flexible coupling for in-line mounting. Sprag-type freewheel clutch insert element manufactured by GMN. This element is a component of a freewheel clutch, designed for one-way power transmission. This type of clutch uses sprags (small, wedge-shaped elements) that engage and disengage based on the direction of rotation, allowing power transmission in only one direction. Features are : High torque and space-saving design, High-speed and precision. GMN offers different configurations with features like inner and outer rings, axle receptions, keyways, and lubrication options. These clutches are commonly used for backstopping, indexing, and overrunning applications. M : Meander Spring. This indicates the spring mechanism used to position the sprags, designed for applications requiring higher indexing speeds.

desc: BALL BEARING FREEWHEEL CLUTCH UNIT FK (2RS)
tech: GMN ball bearing freewheel clutch, specifically the FK series. This type of clutch is designed for low and medium torque applications and is available with integrated ball bearings. It can be used as an overrunning clutch, backstop, or indexing clutch. The \"-RS\" designation indicates that the clutch is sealed, likely with rubber seals on both sides (2RS). GMN ball bearing freewheel clutches are known for their space-saving design, high torque capacity, and suitability for high-speed applications. They utilize a sprag-type mechanism for one-way power transmission. FK series clutches typically consist of an insert element, inner and outer rings, and an integrated ball bearing. GMN ball bearing freewheel clutch units can be lubricated with either oil or grease, and the 2RS models are pre-lubricated and sealed.

The GX50 Roller Clutch is a precision-engineered one-way clutch designed to transmit torque in one direction while overrunning or freewheeling in the opposite direction. It employs high-strength rollers that engage automatically with the raceway to lock rotation, ensuring reliable performance in indexing, backstopping, or overrunning applications.

Key Features


	
	Compact Design: Slim profile for easy integration into machinery.
	
	
	High Torque Transmission: Optimized roller geometry provides maximum surface contact and high torque capacity.
	
	
	Durable Construction: Made of high-grade alloy steel, heat-treated for wear resistance and long service life.
	
	
	Low Maintenance: Requires minimal lubrication, reducing downtime.
	
	
	Precise Engagement: Rollers lock instantly under load without slippage.
	
	
	Bidirectional Options: Designed for one-way rotation, available in both clockwise and counterclockwise models.
	


Typical Applications


	
	Backstopping in conveyors, gearboxes, and pumps.
	
	
	Indexing drives in packaging and printing machinery.
	
	
	Overrunning clutches in speed reducers, agricultural machinery, and material handling equipment.
	
	
	Safety mechanisms to prevent reverse rotation.

HF-KF bearing allows rotation in one direction while locking the bearing in the opposite direction to transmit torque. Its unique design and functionality make it indispensable in various mechanical systems. Features are : Compact Design: This bearing saves space and reduces the overall weight of the machinery or system. Unidirectional Rotation: It allows shafts to rotate freely in one direction while locking and preventing reverse rotation. Torque Transmission: Efficiently transmit torque when engaged, providing high load-carrying capacity due to the line contact of needle rollers. High Load Capacity: It can handle high radial loads due to their design, which distributes the load over a larger area. Low free-wheeling frictional torque, High lock accuracy. KF : Plastic Springs.

desc: TORQUE RELEASER (TORQUE RANGE= 7-24, MAX- SPEED RPM-900)
tech: The SUNTES TX..B-L is an automatic-reset, ball-clutch type mechanical torque limiter / torque releaser engineered by the Japanese industrial manufacturer SANYO SHOJI CO., LTD. It provides highly reliable, instantaneous overload protection for power transmission shafts. When driven system resistance spikes beyond a pre-calibrated limit, the device mechanically cuts power transmission to shield motors, gearboxes, and downstream machinery from catastrophic failure. The product line architecture. It uses a continuous/automatic reset ball-detent mechanism that resets mechanically every 360° rotation once load drops. Features are : High-Speed Rating, Axial Displacement Signal, Low-Inertia, Compact Layout, Low-Stiffness Coil Setup, Wide, Linear Torque Adjustability. Applications : Automated Assembly & Electronics Manufacturing, Packaging & Labeling Machinery, Food, Beverage & Pharmaceutical Processing, Printing & Textile Automation, Machine Tool & Laboratory Equipment. B=Sprocket Type Integration, L=The Low-Torque Spring Rating (White Springs).

desc: TORQUE RELEASER (TORQUE RANGE=8-38, MAX- SPEED RPM-900)
tech: The SUNTES TX...B-H is a high-performance, Japanese-manufactured ball clutch mechanical torque releaser (torque limiter) designed by Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd.. It acts as an automatic overload protection device, instantly decoupling the drive shaft system when torque levels exceed a safe threshold to shield automated machinery from costly structural damage. Features are : High-Speed Overload Protection & Safety Signaling, Lightweight Profile, Low Rotational Inertia, High-Speed Engineering, Compact Footprint, Extended Service, Environmental Stability. Applications : Packaging & Wrapping Lines, Food & Beverage Processing, Printing, Paper, & Converting Machinery, Automated Assembly & Material Handling, Textile & Wire-Winding Equipment, Electronics & Semiconductor Manufacturing, Woodworking & Furniture Manufacturing. B=Sprocket Type Integration, H=Medium Torque Range (Red 5 Spring Rating).

Steel balls are held in the flange by spring pressure. Under normal conditions, they sit in the hub\'s ball pockets to transmit torque. When torque exceeds the limit, the balls push against the springs and roll out of the pockets, instantly decoupling the drive. Features are : Instantaneous Overload Protection, Precise Torque Adjustability, Zero Residual Torque, Low-Inertia Design, Compact Footprint, Positive Axial Displacement, Thermal Protection. Applications : Packaging & Wrapping Machinery, Automated Assembly Lines, Food Processing & Bottling Equipment, Electronics Manufacturing, Printing & Paper Converting, Medical & Pharmaceutical Equipment. D= Flange Type Layout, L=Low Torque With a White Springs.

tech: The SUNTES TX...E-L is a Japanese-manufactured ball-clutch type torque releaser (torque limiter) designed by Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd.. It acts as a mechanical overload protection device that cuts off power transmission to a drive shaft when excessive torque is applied, safeguarding automatic machinery like press machines, kneaders, and plastic molders from catastrophic damage. Utilizes high-precision steel balls seated in machined pockets. This design ensures accurate, repeatable trip torque points compared to friction-style limiters, which can slip prematurely due to wear or oil contamination. Features are : Axial Displacement Signal, Compact and Lightweight Footprint, High Thermal Stability, Minimal Moment of Inertia, Stepless Torque Adjustment, Low Overhang Load. Applications : Automated Packaging Machinery, Electronic Component Assembly, Food and Pharmaceutical Processing, Machine Tool & Printing Auxiliaries, Medical and Laboratory Automation, Semiconductor and Cleanroom Equipment. E=Flange Type Mounting Style, L=Low Torque Rating With White Springs.

desc: TORQUE RELEASER (TORQUE RANGE= 8-38, MAX- SPEED RPM-900)
tech: The SUNTES TX...E-H is a high-performance torque releaser (overload protection ball clutch) manufactured by Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd. in Japan. It functions as a mechanical safety device designed to automatically release a drive shaft system when an overload torque is applied, preventing severe damage to automated industrial machinery. Utilizes high-precision steel balls seated in machined pockets rather than friction plates. This design completely eliminates the slip, wear, and heat generation associated with friction-style limiters during normal operations. Features are :  Low-Maintenance Dynamics, Linear Axial Displacement, Infinite Torque Adjustment, Bi-Directional Torque Protection, Low Inertia Kinetic Profile, Ready-to-Fit Precision Bore, High Torsional Rigidity, Compact Power Density. Applications : Packaging and Bottling Machinery, Material Handling & Automated Feeder Systems,  Printing, Paper, and Textile Processing, Food & Chemical Processing Automation, Electronic and Semiconductor Production, Renewable Energy Systems. E=Flange Type Mounting, H=Medium Torque Range (Red 5 Spring Rating).

desc: TORQUE RELEASER (TORQUE RANGE= 13-50, MAX- SPEED RPM-900)
tech: The SUNTES TX....E-G is an industrial torque releaser (also known as a torque limiter or ball clutch) manufactured by Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd. in Japan. It acts as a mechanical overload protection device that automatically disengages when the transmitted torque exceeds a preset threshold to prevent machine damage. It features a ball clutch mechanism with a continuous/automatic reset type, meaning it re-engages automatically once normal rotation resumes and the overload is cleared. An internal spring presses steel balls into matching pockets on the hub boss, locking the drive components together to transmit power. Features are : Precise Axial Displacement, Wide Torque Adaptability, High-Speed Operational Capability, Compact, Low-Inertia Design, Bidirectional Overload Protection, Integrated Heat Dissipation. Applications : Packaging & Wrapping Machinery, Conveyor & Material Handling Systems, Printing & Paper Converting Equipment, Textile & Spooling Machinery, Cleanroom, Laboratory, & Medical Automation. tech: The SUNTES TY...D-L is a manual-reset, ball-clutch type mechanical torque releaser (torque limiter) engineered by Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd. in Japan. The SUNTES TE is a heavy-duty industrial torque releaser manufactured by SUNTES (a brand under Sanyo Shoji Co., Ltd. in Japan). It operates as an overload safety device featuring a ball clutch / release-type cartridge mechanism designed to protect automated machinery from sudden rotational stress. When the machine encounters resistance exceeding the pre-set torque limit, the internal balls force their way out of the recesses. This triggers a free-rotation retention mechanism that completely detaches the driving force, allowing the assembly to spin freely without friction. Features are : Bi-directional Protection, Contamination Resistance, Isolation of Mechanical Shock, Tamper-Resistant Calibrations, Axial Footprint Space Savings, Zero Residual Heat, Adjustable Limit. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Energy, Mining & Tunnel Boring Technology, Metalworking & Forming Machinery, Paper Mill Calendar Rolls.
